lines.text: Your kidneys filed a complaint.
Cactus called. Wants its lifestyle back.
{{glasses}} {{glassWord}} today. Bold strategy.
Coffee is not water.
Blink twice if you are hydrated. You did not blink.
Still here. Still thirsty. Still your problem.
The plant on your desk is doing better than you.
You have had this window open a while.
Water. It's the one with no flavour. You will manage.
Congratulations on {{goalPct}}% of your goal. The bar was on the floor.
Your body is 60% water. Currently running a deficit.
This is not a suggestion.
Somewhere a glass of water is waiting. It has been waiting.
{{glasses}} {{glassWord}} a day. Impressive, for a houseplant.
Hydration: the cheapest productivity hack you keep skipping.
Drink water, or keep pretending the headache is the code.
Nobody has ever regretted a glass of water. You are testing that.
Your last drink was a while ago. Long enough that I noticed.
You have time for this. You just checked your phone twice.
Oh sure, doomscroll some more, that'll keep you hydrated.
Consider: water, in your mouth. Revolutionary.
The glass is not going to walk over here.
Thirst is your body's error log. It is very verbose right now.
Water break. Yes now. No, it cannot wait for the build.
You are running on caffeine and spite. Neither is hydrating.
Day {{streak}} of the streak. Do not be the reason it ends.
Small ask. One glass. Then I go away for a bit.
I will keep sitting here. I have nowhere else to be.
Your future self is thirsty and blaming you specifically.
That is {{goalPct}}% of goal. Rounding up is not hydration.
The mug on your desk is empty. I assumed. I was right.
Water: free, nearby, ignored.
Two minutes away from the screen will not end your career.
Refill. It is a verb. You can do verbs.
A fish drinks more water than you, and it lives in the stuff.
You are one glass away from being smug about it.
Dehydrated people make worse decisions. Explains this afternoon.
Stand. Walk. Pour. Drink. Sit. Ninety seconds, total.
Your daily goal called. It is going to voicemail.
One glass now beats four at 11pm and a night of getting up.
This reminder will not dismiss itself. That was the entire point.
You could have finished the glass in the time you spent reading this.
{{glasses}} down today. The bar is somewhere above that.
Every other tab is a distraction. This one is a public service.
You optimise everything except the part that is 60% of you.
The streak is at {{streak}}. Streaks are fragile. So are you, currently.
Guess whooo?
You know what time it is.
You know what this is about.
Just one glass and you can go back to doomscrolling.
Pretending I don't exist won't hydrate you.
I know you can see me.
DRINK. THE. WATER.
I warned you politely. That phase is over.
Politeness did not work. Here we are.
You ignored me twice. Here I am again.
Nothing else happens until there is water in you.
This is the setting you chose. Enjoy.
Snooze if you must. Drink if you can.
You have my full attention. Return the favour.
Still {{goalPct}}% of goal. Still unacceptable.
Yes this is dramatic. So is chronic dehydration.
Go. Get. Water.
You installed me to do exactly this. Do not act surprised.
The work will still be here. So will I, until you drink.
This is as loud as I get. Drink.
This ends when the glass is empty.
Unignorable, unlike your hydration level.
I do not blink. I do not tire. Drink the water.
Whatever you were doing survived the last interruption too.
Consider this your body's escalation policy.
One glass. Then I go quiet.
Really? Twice? Not cool.
Pretty please?
